verdict.rationale: Notion's own marketing says it keeps 'work moving 24/7 with agents', and the Agent APIs reference Custom Agents with usage tracking and status management. Together these imply autonomous, recurring automation of team work. Webhooks only push events to an external endpoint, which makes them a developer building block, not a native workflow, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of schedule- or recurrence-based triggers, a workflow/automation builder with defined trigger types, details on how recurring runs are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
